events.title: Expedition of the Guild Launches October 29
events.summary: Hello everyone, I'm Chubby Meow, the developer of Expedition of the Guild.I'm thrilled to announce that Expedition of the Guild officially launches on October 29 at 12:00 PM (Pacific Time)!Over this past stretch, we've been steadily updating the game and reworking parts of the experience:Feature ImprovementsAdded new dungeons: Hidden Forest and Hidden Swamp. events.title: Playtest Now Live — Welcome to Try the Game!
events.summary: Hello everyone, I’m Chubby Meow, the developer of Expedition of the Guild.Thank you all so much for your continued support and interest in Expedition of the Guild! Today, I’m excited to announce that the Steam store page for Expedition of the Guild is officially live! At the same time, the Playtest is now available, and everyone is welcome to jump in and try it out!
